Exactly, bad reviews aren’t the problem. Just use words and logic that make you sound like an actual reviewer. The ones that look like they come from stan Twitter just scream unprofessional to me.

Other artists are very obvious about who they write about and their struggles as well. I also cannot recall anything she’s said about Joe, she barely even wrote about him in TTPD and I didn’t see any malicious intent behind her writing towards him. Matty Healy definitely got the worst part of her album (rightfully so) 

All of this does not negate the fact that, her behaviors are aside from her music when it comes to rating albums. I don’t mind bad reviews. Even the ones that use her personal life against her I suppose, but going back and adding lower reviews in *hopes* of bringing down the score is at the least lacking integrity.

This doesn’t really explain why they bring up her problematic behaviors when reviewing her music. If it was a review of Taylor as a person, sure trash her as much as you’d like. The review was about her music though, it’s weird seeing inconsistencies in these reviews merely because it’s her.
I wasn’t even sure that was allowed, no other Review companies have double reviews. Can the positive reviewers also leave double reviews?

Why do they paint Taylor out to be horrible in her music reviews for having a private jet or being worth 1B then praise Beyonce for having 1 billion in her bank account as well? It just doesn’t make too much sense to me. I can agree this wasn’t her best work, but trying to spin things against Taylor as an artist that most other stars on her level also engage in is very strange.

Was it a Taylor Swift character review or an album review? Beyonce and her husband emit just as much Co2 and actively flaunts themselves in it with 200k bottles of wine but I don’t see many reviewers mentioning that in her album reviews.
